description: Knight-rider blinky on xc7a50tcsg324 clocked from the Sonata board oscillator (left-bank clock-capable pad P15)
exercises: a clock entering on a LEFT-bank clock-capable pad and reaching a BUFG
that the pad-to-BUFG route uses pips prjxray can assemble
why: Every other board test in the suite clocks from a right-bank or bottom pad. P15 on this package lands in LIOI3_X0Y23, and the routes out of that tile pass through HCLK_IOI3, whose IOCLK/RCLK pips are largely unfuzzed in prjxray-db. nextpnr-xilinx 0.9.3 stays out of them (Arch::setup_pip_blacklist plus the dedicated routeClock path); a place-and-route that does not will emit a feature fasm2frames cannot look up, and the test fails at that step with the pip named. Measured 2026-08-27 with the himbaechel port, which routes exactly there with router2 and the default router.
